title: Notification helper references nonexistent entity_type/entity_id columns
evidence: Live notifications has reference_id. Isolated execution reproduced failed message/follow inserts through their triggers; compatibility SQL repairs the shared helper.

title: Direct-chat creator can insert a third member and expose the conversation
evidence: Live conversation_members INSERT policy checks creator only. Isolated baseline insertion succeeded. Proposed grants reserve conversation/member creation to atomic RPCs.

title: All authenticated accounts can read optional profile phone numbers
evidence: profiles SELECT policy is true and authenticated has phone SELECT privilege, confirmed via catalogs. No private phone values were read. Requires a private-data model and compatible profile queries.

title: Legacy direct-conversation RPC bypasses blocking
evidence: Inspected create_direct_conversation(uuid) creates chats without block checks; anonymous execution is also granted, although its auth.uid guard prevents anonymous creation. Proposal delegates to the checked username RPC and revokes anonymous execution.

title: Blocking does not stop existing direct-message sends or calls
evidence: Live messages/call_sessions INSERT policies omit block-pair checks. Proposed restrictive guards were tested with synthetic blocked users.

title: Group key envelopes lack recipient membership and creator restrictions
evidence: Live INSERT repeats the sender membership check twice, without checking target user membership. Proposal restricts distribution to creator and real members; positive and negative isolated tests pass.

title: Call invitations and mutable participant identities lack sufficient restrictions
evidence: Group-call invites do not require target conversation membership; broad UPDATE permits call identity changes. Proposed membership checks and column UPDATE grants preserve lifecycle updates.

title: Encrypted attachment columns are missing in the live messages table
evidence: Client writes media_encrypted, media_encryption_iv and media_mime_type; live catalog has none. Proposal adds them without rewriting existing messages.

title: Atomic group creation references missing conversations.description
evidence: Live function definition and catalog mismatch. Isolated baseline RPC failed, then passed after additive column repair.

title: Chat list selects nonexistent messages.media_encrypted
evidence: src/services/social.js now selects only existing preview fields and preserves encrypted-message/attachment placeholders.

title: Recipient encryption identity is not prepared at sign-in
evidence: Only opening a chat prepared keys, preventing send-to-new-user flows. Auth lifecycle now prepares the identity outside the Supabase auth callback.

title: Concurrent identity setup or a mismatched local key can replace a registered identity
evidence: Identity initialization is serialized per user; conflicting registered/local identities fail closed. Browser tests confirm refusal to replace a key and backup recovery behavior.

title: Voice-note path sends unencrypted media and plaintext body
evidence: VoiceNoteScreen now uses existing ECDH/AES-GCM helpers for both body and media, with no plaintext fallback. Mocked browser integration verifies encrypted writes and missing-key rejection.

title: React Native Web Alert.alert is a no-op
evidence: Installed react-native-web implementation has an empty alert method. Shared accessible browser dialog now executes existing callbacks, including delete-request confirmation; cancel and confirm are browser-tested.

title: Session restoration and signout leave the wrong screen visible
evidence: App shell previously reset to Welcome without user identity dependency. It now routes by user/recovery state. Refresh and signout browser tests pass.

title: Pinned Vite version has reported security advisories
evidence: Baseline npm audit: one high Vite finding and one moderate esbuild finding. Compatible Vite 6.4.6 update, lockfile and Supabase version pin yield zero npm audit advisories.

title: Authenticator enrollment is not enforced during ordinary sign-in or by RLS
evidence: MFA enrollment exists, but LoginScreen does not challenge enrolled factors and protected policies do not require aal2. Do not advertise enforced two-factor protection until challenge/recovery and policy changes are designed and tested.

title: Report submitter can forge moderation outcome fields on INSERT
evidence: Live INSERT checks reporter_id only. Isolated baseline accepted an actioned report with forged moderator_id. Proposed restrictive submission policy requires untouched moderation fields.

title: Change-password screen never calls the authentication backend
evidence: Existing form now validates, reauthenticates with the current password and calls updateUser; rejected and successful mocked flows are tested.

title: Followers/Following screens use empty local arrays
evidence: Existing layouts now load profiles through follows records, persist follow/unfollow, and open real profile routes. Follow-back is tested with mocked backend responses.

title: Conversations over 300 messages load the oldest window
evidence: Query now fetches latest 300 descending and reverses for display. Browser fixture with 305 messages verifies the retained window begins with message 6.

title: Reels uploads use a folder rejected by storage policy
evidence: Live public-media INSERT allows statuses/posts; WatchScreen uploads reels/user-id. Proposal adds the existing Reels folder to the owner-scoped policy, with isolated ownership tests.

title: Privacy switches do not enforce account/status/media privacy
evidence: Account/Status privacy controls are local selections. Active statuses are readable by authenticated users; the media bucket is public and URLs survive row expiry. Requires product rules, private media authorization and cleanup design; changing bucket publicity alone would break current URLs.

title: Notification trigger copies private message bodies
evidence: Inspected konnekt_notify_message copies body into notification records. Proposal emits a generic message notification; isolated checks confirm no plaintext duplication.

title: Edge Function artifacts are not deployable or schema-compatible as laid out
evidence: Seven index*.ts artifacts are at repository root, import missing ../_shared/cors.ts, and several reference absent reports/blocked_users/other staging tables. Live project lists zero Edge Functions. Syntax transpilation alone does not validate these imports or services.

title: Account deletion is a request-only workflow
evidence: UI correctly states requests require administrator/backend completion. No trusted media erasure/session revocation/final-deletion workflow is deployed. Destructive deletion was not attempted.

title: Signed Android release workflow copies absent android-res files
evidence: Workflow now installs existing repository icon/splash assets using scripts/android-assets.mjs. Generation, asset installation and Capacitor sync were executed successfully; no signed package was built.

title: Dependency installs are not reproducible
evidence: Original repository has no lockfile and workflows use npm install. Committed lockfile, exact Supabase pin and npm ci make checked installations repeatable.

title: No executable lint/regression suite or pull-request CI
evidence: Added lint rules for runtime errors in canonical JSX/services, isolated PostgreSQL tests, service-worker tests and intercepted-browser tests. CI validates web/mobile builds and tests without deploying.

title: Narrow-screen Reels and Status headers overflow
evidence: Reels header wraps; Status text column shrinks. All six tabs pass horizontal-overflow checks at 320, 390 and 1280 pixels.

title: PWA manifest hardcodes GitHub Pages paths in mobile builds
evidence: Manifest id/scope/start_url/icons now resolve relative to its location, preserving /KONNEKT/ web hosting and relative Capacitor assets.

title: Push notification click can navigate outside application scope
evidence: Service worker now limits targets to the same origin and registration path. Tests reject external, javascript and sibling-app destinations.

title: Live room video is only a local camera preview
evidence: Source explicitly states no broadcast transport is configured. Room chat is separate from streaming. Requires streaming/SFU provider and real host/viewer tests.

title: Creator monetisation has no transaction/payment backend
evidence: Subscriptions, funded earnings, payouts, gifts and verification workflows remain partial or explicitly unavailable. No payment credentials or transactions were invented.

title: Reliable cross-network calling lacks supplied TURN configuration
evidence: Default build uses STUN; no VITE_TURN_CREDENTIALS_URL is supplied by the deployment workflow. Requires short-lived credential service and real two-device/two-network verification.

title: Background push is not configured in the deployment
evidence: No OneSignal app ID is supplied by the workflow; no push Edge Function is deployed. Browser alerts while open do not prove background push delivery.

title: File picker cancellation can leave a pending promise
evidence: Media chooser now resolves null on the browser cancel event, while retaining change/error handling.

title: Media helper permits 50 MB while promising a 45 MB video limit
evidence: Shared validation now enforces the existing 45 MB product limit consistently.

title: Eager screen registry creates a large entry bundle
evidence: Production build warns about an approximately 1 MB JavaScript entry chunk. Warning remains visible; no arbitrary threshold increase or broad architecture rewrite was made.

title: Duplicate source trees and obsolete package notes obscure the canonical app
evidence: Root screens and many src/screens/*.js duplicate the active JSX tree. Main entry uses App.jsx and src/screens/*.jsx. Duplicates were inventoried and retained to avoid deleting potentially needed artifacts.

title: Database has redundant policies/indexes and optimization advisories
evidence: Live advisors report duplicate indexes, multiple permissive policies, unindexed FKs and per-row auth calls. These are grouped as one performance finding; no speculative index deletion was performed.
